sonnet.problem: The card calls the plumb-line vision of 7:7-9 Amos's "last vision." That is not true. Amos 8:1 and 9:1 give further visions, so the card states a Bible fact the text does not support.
sonnet.rule: Every fact and every verse number comes from that text.

sonnet.problem: The card says Amos is "a man from Tekoa in Judah." That gives away the answer to the later fill-in-the-blank on card 7 ("flee to the land of ___" = Judah) and makes the wrong answers Egypt and Moab easy to rule out.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card says Amos "has been bringing the LORD's word to Israel." That gives away the answer to card 13 (where the LORD told Amos to go prophesy = Israel) and rules out Nineveh and Egypt.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The card says Amos "starts with what he did for a living before any of this." That tells the baker he had another job before he prophesied, which gives away the answer to the true/false on card 11 ("has always been a prophet" = False).
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
